function onLoad(save_state)
    if save_state ~= '' then
        saveState = JSON.decode(save_state)
    end
    --initializeData()
    freeze() -- Make objects non-interactive

    agentsBag = getObjectFromGUID(agentsBag)
    safehousesBag = getObjectFromGUID(safehousesBag)
    incidentsBag = getObjectFromGUID(incidentsBag)
    local trackingTokensBag = getObjectFromGUID(GUID_TRACKING_TOKEN_BAG)
    clearHotkeys()

    addHotkey("Add Agents", function (playerColor, hoveredObject, cursorLocation, key_down_up)
      if #agentsBag.getObjects() == 0 then
        broadcastToAll("There are no Agents left to place. The game is over.", Color.SoftYellow)
      else
        agentsBag.takeObject({position=cursorLocation,rotation=Vector(0,180,0)})
      end
    end)

    addHotkey("Add Safehouses", function (playerColor, hoveredObject, cursorLocation, key_down_up)
      if #safehousesBag.getObjects() == 0 then
        broadcastToAll("There are no Safehouses left to place.", Color.SoftYellow)
      else
        safehousesBag.takeObject({position=cursorLocation,rotation=Vector(0,180,0)})
      end
    end)

    addHotkey("Add Incidents", function (playerColor, hoveredObject, cursorLocation, key_down_up)
      if #incidentsBag.getObjects() == 0 then
        broadcastToAll("There are no Incidents left to place. The game is over.", Color.SoftYellow)
      else
        incidentsBag.takeObject({position=cursorLocation,rotation=Vector(0,180,0)})
      end
    end)

    addHotkey("Add Tracking Token", function (playerColor, hoveredObject, cursorLocation, key_down_up)
      if #trackingTokensBag.getObjects() == 0 then
        broadcastToAll("There are no Tracking Tokens left to place.", Color.SoftYellow)
      else
        trackingTokensBag.takeObject({position=cursorLocation,rotation=Vector(0,180,0)})
      end
    end)
end

function pullEventCards(deck, wantedCards, matchedCards, offsetX)
    for _, card in ipairs(deck.getObjects()) do
        for _, wantedCard in ipairs(wantedCards) do
            if card.name == mapEventCard(wantedCard) then
                if deck.remainder == nil then
                    table.insert(matchedCards, deck.takeObject(
                        {
                            guid = card.guid,
                            position = { offsetX, 3, -15 }
                        }
                    ))
                else
                    deck.remainder.setPosition({ offsetX, 3, - 15})
                    table.insert(matchedCards, deck.remainder)
                end
                offsetX = offsetX + 2
                break
            end
        end
    end
    return matchedCards
end

function collateEventCards(eventDeck, legacyOneDeck)
    local selectedCards = getSelectedEventCards()
    if #selectedCards == 0 then
        destroyObject(eventDeck)
        return {}
    end

    local eventCards = pullEventCards(eventDeck, selectedCards, {}, -27)
    eventCards = pullEventCards(legacyOneDeck, selectedCards, eventCards, -27 + (2 * #eventCards))
    destroyObject(eventDeck)
    return eventCards
end

function setupGame(setupConfig, debriefingConfig, targets, infectionsConfig)
    resetThreatMarkerPosition()
    if infectionsConfig.africa ~= nil and #infectionsConfig.africa > 3 then
        broadcastToAll("No more than three cities in Africa may be infected.", {r=1,g=0,b=0})
        return
    end

    local deck = createPlayerCityDeck()
    local escalations = setupEscalations()
    local legacyOneDeck = createLegacyOneDeck()
    local operationsDeck = createOperationsDeck()
    local eventCards = collateEventCards(createEventDeck(), legacyOneDeck)

    regionalCards = {}
    offset = 0
    for _, config in ipairs(setupConfig) do
        region = {}
        for _, playerCard in ipairs(deck.getObjects()) do
            desiredCards = config["cards"]
            for _, desiredCard in ipairs(desiredCards) do
                if playerCard.name == desiredCard then
                    card = deck.takeObject({ guid = playerCard.guid, position = { -27.5807076 + offset, 0, 0 }})
                    table.insert(region, card)
                    offset = offset + 2
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        table.insert(regionalCards, region)
    end

    if infectionsConfig.africa ~= nil then
        local africaInfectionCards = { "02-06", "02-07", "02-08" }
        local index = 1
        for _, city in ipairs(infectionsConfig.africa) do
            for _, legacyCard in ipairs(legacyOneDeck.getObjects()) do
                if legacyCard.name == africaInfectionCards[index] then
                    index = index + 1
                    local infectionCard = legacyOneDeck.takeObject({
                        guid = legacyCard.guid,
                        position = { 26.7355461, 3, 16.3091545 },
                        rotation = { 0, 270, 0 },
                        smooth = true,
                    })
                    infectionCard.setName(city)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if infectionsConfig.southAmerica ~= nil then
        local southAmericaInfectionCards = { "04-16", "04-17", "04-18" }
        local index = 1
        for _, city in ipairs(infectionsConfig.southAmerica) do
            for _, legacyCard in ipairs(legacyOneDeck.getObjects()) do
                if legacyCard.name == southAmericaInfectionCards[index] then
                    index = index + 1
                    local infectionCard = legacyOneDeck.takeObject({
                        guid = legacyCard.guid,
                        position = { 26.7355461, 3, 16.3091545 },
                        rotation = { 0, 270, 0 },
                        smooth = true,
                    })
                    infectionCard.setName(city)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end

    Wait.time(
        function()
            local regionDecks = {}
            for _, regionalCard in ipairs(regionalCards) do
                local regionDeck = group(regionalCard)[1]
                regionDeck.shuffle()
                table.insert(regionDecks, regionDeck)
            end

            for i, config in ipairs(setupConfig) do
                for j = 1, config["count"], 1 do
                    rotationY = 0
                    if config["hidden"] then
                        rotationY = 180
                    end
                    offsetX = config["objective"] - 1
                    local removedCard = regionDecks[i].takeObject({
                        position = {
                            -26.3 + (offsetX * 9.54) + (2 - (config["count"] - j)),
                            2.829987 + (j - 1),
                            17.0683022 + ((config["count"] - j) * 1.4)
                        },
                        rotation = { 0, 180, rotationY },
                    })
                    -- revealed cards should be removed from the card tracker
                    if not config["hidden"] then
                        removeCityCardFromTracker(removedCard.getName())
                    end
                end
            end

            for _, target in ipairs(targets.tracking) do
                placeTrackerToken(target)
            end

            for _, target in ipairs(targets.pursuit) do
                placePursuitToken(target)
            end

            placeSafehouseInWashington()

            local legacyDeck = legacyOneDeck
            arrangeDebriefing(legacyDeck, debriefingConfig.debriefing, debriefingConfig.postgame)
            arrangeObjectives(legacyDeck, operationsDeck, debriefingConfig.objectives)
            destroyObject(legacyDeck)
            destroyObject(operationsDeck)

            mergedRegions = group(regionDecks)[1]
            local grouping = { deck, mergedRegions }
            for _, eventCard in ipairs(eventCards) do
                table.insert(grouping, eventCard)
            end
            deck = group(grouping)[1]
            deck.shuffle()

            players = #Player.getPlayers()
            if players == 3 then
                deck.deal(3)
            elseif players == 4 then
                deck.deal(2)
            else
                deck.deal(4)
            end

            splitDeck(deck, escalations)
            -- UI seems to lag so wait before refreshing the region tracker
            Wait.time(
                function()
                    if currentCardTrackerRegion ~= nil then
                        showRegion(currentCardTrackerRegion)
                    end
                end
            , 1)
        end,
        1
    )
end

function splitDeck(deck, escalations)
    splitTable = deck.split(5)
    x = -14
    for i = 1, 5, 1 do
        splitTable[i].setPosition({x, 2, -5 })
        splitTable[i].setRotation({ 0, 180, 180 })
        splitTable[i] = group({splitTable[i], escalations[i]})[1]
        splitTable[i].shuffle()
        x = x + 7
    end
    completed = group(splitTable)[1]
    completed.setPosition({ 7.16310358, 2.0047152, -15.2567453 })
end

function arrangeDebriefing(legacyDeck, debriefingCards, postgameGroups)
    for i = 1, #debriefingCards, 1 do
        for _, legacyCard in ipairs(legacyDeck.getObjects()) do
            if legacyCard.name == debriefingCards[i]["name"] then
                rotationValue = 0
                if debriefingCards[i]["flip"] then
                    rotationValue = 180
                end

                legacyDeck.takeObject({
                    guid = legacyCard.guid,
                    position = { -27.3880138 + ((i - 1) * 5.5), 1.7719456, 8,},
                    rotation = {0, 180, rotationValue },
                    smooth = true,
                })
                break
            end
        end
    end

    for i = 1, #postgameGroups, 1 do
        local postgameCards = postgameGroups[i]
        local offset = #debriefingCards + (i - 1)
        for i = #postgameCards, 1, -1 do
            for _, legacyCard in ipairs(legacyDeck.getObjects()) do
                if legacyCard.name == postgameCards[i] then
                    local verticalOffset = #postgameCards - i * 0.3
                    legacyDeck.takeObject({
                        guid = legacyCard.guid,
                        position = { -27.3880138 + (offset * 5.5), 1.7719456 + verticalOffset, 8 },
                        rotation = { 0, 180, 0 },
                        smooth = true,
                    })
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function arrangeObjectives(legacyDeck, operationsDeck, cards)
    for i = 1, #cards, 1 do
        for _, legacyCard in ipairs(legacyDeck.getObjects()) do
            if legacyCard.name == cards[i] then
                legacyDeck.takeObject({
                    guid = legacyCard.guid,
                    position = {-22.2 + ((i - 1) * 9.54), 5, 16.1298637},
                    rotation = {0, 270, 180},
                    smooth = true,
                })
                break
            end
        end

        for _, operationsCard in ipairs(operationsDeck.getObjects()) do
            if operationsCard.name == cards[i] then
                operationsDeck.takeObject({
                    guid = operationsCard.guid,
                    position = {-22.2 + ((i - 1) * 9.54), 5, 16.1298637},
                    rotation = {0, 270, 0},
                    smooth = true,
                })
                break
            end
        end
    end
end

function getMissionIndex(mission)
    if mission == "Prologue" then return 1
    elseif mission == "January (first half)" then return 2
    elseif mission == "January (second half)" then return 3
    elseif mission == "February (first half)" then return 4
    elseif mission == "February (second half)" then return 5
    elseif mission == "March (first half)" then return 6
    elseif mission == "March (second half)" then return 7
    elseif mission == "April (first half)" then return 8
    elseif mission == "April (second half)" then return 9
    elseif mission == "May (first half)" then return 10
    end
end

-- Get the number of infected regions for a given mission. This should
-- be a non-negative integer.
function getInfectedRegions(mission)
    if mission == "Prologue" or
            mission == "January (first half)" or
            mission == "January (second half)" or
            mission == "February (first half)" or
            mission == "February (second half)" then
        return 0
    elseif mission == "April (second half)" or
            mission == "May (first half)" then
        return 2
    end
    return 1
end

function getPanel(xmlTable, id)
    for _, child in ipairs(xmlTable) do
        if child["attributes"]["id"] == id then
            return child
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function missionDropdownSelected(player, mission, id)
    local missionIndex = getMissionIndex(mission)
    local eventCardsConfig = eventCardsSelectionMap[missionIndex]

    local xmlTable = Global.UI.getXmlTable()
    local setupPanel = getPanel(xmlTable, "setupPanel")
    -- update which control has been selected explicitly because we're rewriting the UI
    local missionDropdown = setupPanel["children"][2]
    missionDropdown["attributes"]["selected"] = mission
    for i, option in ipairs(missionDropdown["children"]) do
        option["attributes"]["selected"] = i == missionIndex
    end
    local missionScrollView = setupPanel["children"][4]
    local missionLayout = missionScrollView["children"][1]
    local availableCards = {}
    -- update list of event cards based on the selected mission
    for i, card in ipairs(eventCardsConfig["cards"]) do
        table.insert(availableCards, {
            tag = "Toggle",
            value = card,
            attributes = {
                id = "event" .. i,
                isOn = eventCardsConfig["selected"],
                onValueChanged = "eventCardToggled",
                height = 30,
                width = 430,
                fontStyle = "Bold",
                fontSize = 16,
                color = "#000000"
            }
        })
    end
    -- adjust layout height to accommodate the new cards
    missionLayout["attributes"]["height"] = #eventCardsConfig["cards"] * 30
    missionLayout["children"] = availableCards

    if getInfectedRegions(mission) > 0 then
        Global.UI.setAttribute("startBtn", "text", "Next")
    else
        Global.UI.setAttribute("startBtn", "text", "Start")
    end
    Global.UI.setXmlTable(xmlTable)
end

    local xmlTable = Global.UI.getXmlTable()
    local panel = getPanel(xmlTable, "infectionPanel")
    panel["attributes"]["height"] = panelAttributes.height
    panel["attributes"]["width"] = panelAttributes.width
    local children = {}
    table.insert(children, createTitleText(infectedRegions))

function setupEscalations()
    escalations = {}
    for i = 1, 5, 1 do
        escalation = takeEscalation()
        escalation.setPosition({ 27, 2 + i, -2 * i })
        escalation.setRotation({ 0, 180, 0 })
        escalations[i] = escalation
    end
    return escalations
end

function hideCities(cities)
    for _, cityName in pairs(cities) do
        local converted = removeSpaces(cityName)
        Global.UI.hide(converted)
    end
end

function resetRegion(cities)
    for _, cityName in pairs(cities) do
        local converted = removeSpaces(cityName)
        Global.UI.setAttribute(converted, "cardDrawn", "false")
    end
end

function resetRegionTracker()
    resetRegion(africaCityNames)
    resetRegion(asiaCityNames)
    resetRegion(europeCityNames)
    resetRegion(northAmericaCityNames)
    resetRegion(pacificRimCityNames)
    resetRegion(southAmericaCityNames)
    showRegion(currentCardTrackerRegion)
end

function inTable(cities, cityName)
    for _, city in pairs(cities) do
        if city == cityName then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

function hasBeenDrawn(cityName)
    local converted = removeSpaces(cityName)
    return Global.UI.getAttribute(converted, "cardDrawn") == "true"
end

function getRemainder(cities)
    local count = 0
    for _, cityName in pairs(cities) do
        if not hasBeenDrawn(cityName) then
            count = count + 1
        end
    end
    return count
end

function showCities(region, cities)
    currentCardTrackerRegion = region
    hideCities({ "Allied", "Neutral", "Soviet" })
    hideCities(africaCityNames)
    hideCities(asiaCityNames)
    hideCities(europeCityNames)
    hideCities(northAmericaCityNames)
    hideCities(pacificRimCityNames)
    hideCities(southAmericaCityNames)

    local visible = 0
    for _, cityName in pairs(cities) do
        -- this hasn't been drawn yet, show this city in the tracker
        if not hasBeenDrawn(cityName) then
            Global.UI.show(removeSpaces(cityName))
            visible = visible + 1
        end
    end

    if region == "Allegiance" then
        local allied = getRemainder(CITY_NAMES_ALLIED)
        local neutral = getRemainder(CITY_NAMES_NEUTRAL)
        local soviet = getRemainder(CITY_NAMES_SOVIET)
        Global.UI.setAttribute("Allied", "text", "Allied " .. allied .. "/14")
        Global.UI.setAttribute("Neutral", "text", "Neutral " .. neutral .. "/20")
        Global.UI.setAttribute("Soviet", "text", "Soviet " .. soviet .. "/14")
        Global.UI.show("Allied")
        Global.UI.show("Neutral")
        Global.UI.show("Soviet")
        Global.UI.setAttribute(ID_TEXT_CARD_TRACKER_HEADER, "text", "Allegiance")
    else
        Global.UI.setAttribute(ID_TEXT_CARD_TRACKER_HEADER, "text", region .. " " .. visible .. "/" .. #cities)
    end
    
    Global.UI.show(ID_TEXT_CARD_TRACKER_HEADER)
    Global.UI.setAttribute("regionsPanel", "height", 32 * (visible + 1))
    Global.UI.setAttribute("regionCardsLayout", "height", 32 * (visible + 1))
end

function showRegion(region)
    if region == REGION_AFRICA then
        showCities(REGION_AFRICA, africaCityNames)
    elseif region == REGION_ASIA then
        showCities(REGION_ASIA, asiaCityNames)
    elseif region == REGION_EUROPE then
        showCities(REGION_EUROPE, europeCityNames)
    elseif region == REGION_NORTH_AMERICA then
        showCities(REGION_NORTH_AMERICA, northAmericaCityNames)
    elseif region == REGION_PACIFIC_RIM then
        showCities(REGION_PACIFIC_RIM, pacificRimCityNames)
    elseif region == REGION_SOUTH_AMERICA then
        showCities(REGION_SOUTH_AMERICA, southAmericaCityNames)
    elseif region == "Allegiance" then
        showCities(region, { "Allied", "Neutral", "Soviet" })
    end
end

-- explicitly toggle the state in the XML
function eventCardToggled(player, value, id)
    if value == "True" then value = "true"
    else value = "false"
    end
    Global.UI.setAttribute(id, "isOn", value)
end

function getSelectedEventCards()
    local xmlTable = Global.UI.getXmlTable()
    local setupPanel = getPanel(xmlTable, "setupPanel")
    if setupPanel == nil then
        return {}
    end

    local missionScrollView = setupPanel["children"][4]
    local missionLayout = missionScrollView["children"][1]
    local selectedCards = {}
    for _, card in ipairs(missionLayout["children"]) do
        if card["attributes"]["isOn"] == "true" then
            table.insert(selectedCards, card["value"])
        end
    end
    return selectedCards
end

function removeSpaces(text)
    return string.gsub(text, " ", "")
end

-- Removes the given city from the card tracker.
function removeCityCardFromTracker(cityName)
    local converted = removeSpaces(cityName)
    Global.UI.setAttribute(converted, "cardDrawn", "true")
    -- wait because Global.UI.getAttribute(*) has a lag and will not
    -- retrieve the updated attribute immediately
    Wait.time(
        function()
            -- force the UI to show/hide everything so it resizes again
            showRegion(currentCardTrackerRegion)
        end
    , 1)
end

function onObjectEnterZone(zone, object)
    for _, hand in ipairs(Hands.getHands()) do
        if hand == zone then
            for _, tag in ipairs(object.getTags()) do
                if tag == "player" then
                    removeCityCardFromTracker(object.getName())
                    return
                end
            end
            return
        end
    end
end

function getInfections(parentElementId)
    local xmlTable = Global.UI.getXmlTable()
    local infectionPanel = getPanel(xmlTable, "infectionPanel")
    if infectionPanel == nil then
        -- this shouldn't happen
        return {}
    end

    for _, panelChild in ipairs(infectionPanel["children"]) do
        if panelChild["attributes"]["id"] == parentElementId then
            local layout = panelChild["children"][1]
            local infectedCities = {}
            for _, card in ipairs(layout["children"]) do
                if card["attributes"]["isOn"] == "true" then
                    table.insert(infectedCities, card["value"])
                end
            end
            return infectedCities
        end
    end
    return {}
end

    local mission = Global.UI.getAttribute("missionDropdown", "selected")

    if infectedRegions > 0 then

        toggleInfectionPanelVisibility()
    else

saveState = {}

function onLoad(save_state)
    if save_state ~= nil then
        saveState = JSON.decode(save_state)
    end
    if saveState == nil then
        saveState = {}
    end
    if saveState['checkedIndex'] == nil then
        saveState['checkedIndex'] = {}
    end

    createindexChecks()
    self.script_state = JSON.encode(saveState)
end

function createindexChecks()
  for i = 1, 13 do
      local row = (i - 1) % 1
      local column = math.floor((i - 1) / 1)
      local buttonPosition = {-1.494 + (column * 0.1135), 0.2, -0.615 + (row * 0.03428)}

        local check = ''
        if saveState['checkedIndex'][i] then
            check = "\u{2717}"
        end

        _G['toggleIndex' .. i] = function() toggleIndex(i) end
        self.createButton({
            click_function = 'toggleIndex' .. i,
            function_owner = self,
            tooltip        = "Click to complete",
            label          = check,
            position       = buttonPosition,
            width          = 500,
            height         = 400, -- int,
            scale          = {0.1, 0.1, 0.1},
            font_size      = 550,
            color          = {0,0,0,0},
            font_color     = {1,0,0,130},
        })
    end
end

function toggleIndex(index)
    local check = ''
    if saveState['checkedIndex'][index] then
        saveState['checkedIndex'][index] = nil
    else
        saveState['checkedIndex'][index] = true
        check = 'x'
    end

    for _, button in pairs(self.getButtons()) do
        if button.click_function == 'toggleIndex' .. index then
            self.editButton({index = button.index, label = check})
        end
    end

    self.script_state = JSON.encode(saveState)
end

function onload(saved_data)

    vals = {}
    for i=0,54 do
        vals[tostring(i)] = ""
    end

    if saved_data ~= "" then
        vals = JSON.decode(saved_data)
    end

    createAll()
end

function updateSave()
    vals = {}
    for _,input in pairs(self.getInputs()) do
        vals[tostring(input.index)] = tostring(input.value)
    end

    saved_data = JSON.encode(vals)
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

function createAll()
    f_color = {0,0,0,100}
    b_color = {0,0,0,80/250}
    idx = 0
    for i=0,23 do
        -- Funding
        self.createInput({
            input_function = "saveInput",
            tooltip="",
            label = "",
            value = vals[tostring(idx)],
            function_owner = self,
            alignment = 3,
            position = {-0.372,0.12,-0.599+(i*0.0421)},
            width = 400,
            height = 160,
            font_size = 125,
            scale = {x=0.1, y=0.1, z=0.1},
            font_color = f_color,
            color = b_color
            })
        idx = idx + 1

        -- Players
        self.createInput({
            input_function = "saveInput",
            tooltip="",
            label = "",
            value = vals[tostring(idx)],
            function_owner = self,
            alignment = 2,
            position = {-0.069,0.12,-0.599+(i*0.0421)},
            width = 2300,
            height = 160,
            font_size = 125,
            scale = {x=0.1, y=0.1, z=0.1},
            font_color = f_color,
            color = b_color
            })
        idx = idx + 1

        -- Date
        self.createInput({
            input_function = "saveInput",
            tooltip="",
            label = "",
            value = vals[tostring(idx)],
            function_owner = self,
            alignment = 2,
            position = {0.277,0.12,-0.599+(i*0.0421)},
            width = 850,
            height = 160,
            font_size = 125,
            scale = {x=0.1, y=0.1, z=0.1},
            font_color = f_color,
            color = b_color
            })
        idx = idx + 1

        -- Evaluation
        self.createInput({
            input_function = "saveInput",
            tooltip="",
            label = "",
            value = vals[tostring(idx)],
            function_owner = self,
            alignment = 2,
            position = {0.497,0.12,-0.599+(i*0.0421)},
            width = 1100,
            height = 160,
            font_size = 125,
            scale = {x=0.1, y=0.1, z=0.1},
            font_color = f_color,
            color = b_color
            })
        idx = idx + 1
    end
end

function removeAll()
    for _,input in pairs(self.getInputs()) do
        self.removeInput(input.index)
    end
    self.setName("")
    self.setDescription("")
end

function reloadAll()
    removeAll()
    createAll()
    updateSave()
end

function saveInput(_obj, _player, value, selected)
    updateSave()
end

function saveName(_obj, _player, value)
    _obj.setName(value)
end

function saveDescription(_obj, _player, value)
    _obj.setDescription(value)
end

saveState = {}

function onLoad(save_state)
    if save_state ~= nil then
        saveState = JSON.decode(save_state)
    end
    if saveState == nil then
        saveState = {}
    end
    if saveState['checkedIndex'] == nil then
        saveState['checkedIndex'] = {}
    end

    createindexChecks()
    self.script_state = JSON.encode(saveState)
end

function createindexChecks()
  for i = 1, 4 do
      local row = (i - 1) % 4
      local column = math.floor((i - 1) / 4)
      local buttonPosition = {0.7 + (column * 0.01), -0.25, 0.71 + (row * 0.21)}

        local check = ''
        if saveState['checkedIndex'][i] then
            check = 'x'
        end

        _G['toggleIndex' .. i] = function() toggleIndex(i) end
        self.createButton({
            click_function = 'toggleIndex' .. i,
            function_owner = self,
            label          = check,
            position       = buttonPosition,
            rotation       = {0, 0, 180},
            width          = 80,
            height         = 80, -- int,
            scale          = {1, 1, 1},
            font_size      = 100,
            color          = {0,0,0,0},
            font_color     = {1,0,0,130},
        })
    end
end

function toggleIndex(index)
    local check = ''
    if saveState['checkedIndex'][index] then
        saveState['checkedIndex'][index] = nil
    else
        saveState['checkedIndex'][index] = true
        check = 'x'
    end

    for _, button in pairs(self.getButtons()) do
        if button.click_function == 'toggleIndex' .. index then
            self.editButton({index = button.index, label = check})
        end
    end

    self.script_state = JSON.encode(saveState)
end

  bag.takeObject({position = {-76.85, 1.5, 41.92}, rotation = {0, 180, 0}, smooth = true })

  local ruleB = bag.takeObject({position = {-62.09, 1.5, 27.95}, rotation = {0, 180, 0}, smooth = false }) --B

  bag.takeObject({position = {34.62, 2, -3.67}, rotation = {0, 180, 0}, smooth = false }) --cube

saveState = {}

function onLoad(save_state)
    if save_state ~= nil then
        saveState = JSON.decode(save_state)
    end
    if saveState == nil then
        saveState = {}
    end
    if saveState['checkedIndex'] == nil then
        saveState['checkedIndex'] = {}
    end

    createindexChecks()
    self.script_state = JSON.encode(saveState)
end

function createindexChecks()
  for i = 1, 3 do
      local row = (i - 1) % 1
      local column = math.floor((i - 1) / 1)
      local buttonPosition = {1.74 + (column * 0.4274), 0.1, 0.69 + (row * 0.03428)}

        local check = ''
        if saveState['checkedIndex'][i] then
            check = 'x'
        end

        _G['toggleIndex' .. i] = function() toggleIndex(i) end
        self.createButton({
            click_function = 'toggleIndex' .. i,
            function_owner = self,
            label          = check,
            position       = buttonPosition,
            width          = 200,
            height         = 200, -- int,
            scale          = {1, 1, 1},
            font_size      = 210,
            color          = {0,0,0,0},
            font_color     = {1,0,0,130},
        })
    end
end

function toggleIndex(index)
    local check = ''
    if saveState['checkedIndex'][index] then
        saveState['checkedIndex'][index] = nil
    else
        saveState['checkedIndex'][index] = true
        check = 'x'
    end

    for _, button in pairs(self.getButtons()) do
        if button.click_function == 'toggleIndex' .. index then
            self.editButton({index = button.index, label = check})
        end
    end

    self.script_state = JSON.encode(saveState)
end

saveState = {}

function onLoad(save_state)
    if save_state ~= nil then
        saveState = JSON.decode(save_state)
    end
    if saveState == nil then
        saveState = {}
    end
    if saveState['checkedIndex'] == nil then
        saveState['checkedIndex'] = {}
    end

    createindexChecks()
    self.script_state = JSON.encode(saveState)
end

function createindexChecks()
  for i = 1, 4 do
      local row = (i - 1) % 4
      local column = math.floor((i - 1) / 4)
      local buttonPosition = {0.7 + (column * 0.01), -0.25, 0.71 + (row * 0.21)}

        local check = ''
        if saveState['checkedIndex'][i] then
            check = 'x'
        end

        _G['toggleIndex' .. i] = function() toggleIndex(i) end
        self.createButton({
            click_function = 'toggleIndex' .. i,
            function_owner = self,
            label          = check,
            position       = buttonPosition,
            rotation       = {0, 0, 180},
            width          = 80,
            height         = 80, -- int,
            scale          = {1, 1, 1},
            font_size      = 100,
            color          = {0,0,0,0},
            font_color     = {1,0,0,130},
        })
    end
end

function toggleIndex(index)
    local check = ''
    if saveState['checkedIndex'][index] then
        saveState['checkedIndex'][index] = nil
    else
        saveState['checkedIndex'][index] = true
        check = 'x'
    end

    for _, button in pairs(self.getButtons()) do
        if button.click_function == 'toggleIndex' .. index then
            self.editButton({index = button.index, label = check})
        end
    end

    self.script_state = JSON.encode(saveState)
end

saveState = {}

function onLoad(save_state)
    if save_state ~= nil then
        saveState = JSON.decode(save_state)
    end
    if saveState == nil then
        saveState = {}
    end
    if saveState['checkedIndex'] == nil then
        saveState['checkedIndex'] = {}
    end

    createindexChecks()
    self.script_state = JSON.encode(saveState)
end

function createindexChecks()
  for i = 1, 10 do
      local row = (i - 1) %5
      local column = math.floor((i - 1) / 5)
      local buttonPosition = {0.24 + (column * 0.28), -0.25, -1.39 + (row * 0.23)}

        local check = ''
        if saveState['checkedIndex'][i] then
            check = 'x'
        end

        _G['toggleIndex' .. i] = function() toggleIndex(i) end
        self.createButton({
            click_function = 'toggleIndex' .. i,
            function_owner = self,
            label          = check,
            position       = buttonPosition,
            rotation       = {0, 90, 180},
            width          = 65,
            height         = 80, -- int,
            scale          = {1, 1, 1},
            font_size      = 100,
            color          = {0,0,0,0},
            font_color     = {1,0,0,130},
        })
    end
end

function toggleIndex(index)
    local check = ''
    if saveState['checkedIndex'][index] then
        saveState['checkedIndex'][index] = nil
    else
        saveState['checkedIndex'][index] = true
        check = 'x'
    end

    for _, button in pairs(self.getButtons()) do
        if button.click_function == 'toggleIndex' .. index then
            self.editButton({index = button.index, label = check})
        end
    end

    self.script_state = JSON.encode(saveState)
end

saveState = {}

function onLoad(save_state)
    if save_state ~= nil then
        saveState = JSON.decode(save_state)
    end
    if saveState == nil then
        saveState = {}
    end
    if saveState['checkedIndex'] == nil then
        saveState['checkedIndex'] = {}
    end

    createindexChecks()
    self.script_state = JSON.encode(saveState)
end

function createindexChecks()
  for i = 1, 4 do
      local row = (i - 1) % 4
      local column = math.floor((i - 1) / 4)
      local buttonPosition = {0.7 + (column * 0.01), -0.25, 0.71 + (row * 0.21)}

        local check = ''
        if saveState['checkedIndex'][i] then
            check = 'x'
        end

        _G['toggleIndex' .. i] = function() toggleIndex(i) end
        self.createButton({
            click_function = 'toggleIndex' .. i,
            function_owner = self,
            label          = check,
            position       = buttonPosition,
            rotation       = {0, 0, 180},
            width          = 80,
            height         = 80, -- int,
            scale          = {1, 1, 1},
            font_size      = 100,
            color          = {0,0,0,0},
            font_color     = {1,0,0,130},
        })
    end
end

function toggleIndex(index)
    local check = ''
    if saveState['checkedIndex'][index] then
        saveState['checkedIndex'][index] = nil
    else
        saveState['checkedIndex'][index] = true
        check = 'x'
    end

    for _, button in pairs(self.getButtons()) do
        if button.click_function == 'toggleIndex' .. index then
            self.editButton({index = button.index, label = check})
        end
    end

    self.script_state = JSON.encode(saveState)
end

Scripting works by pulling a new Legacy Deck out of the infinite bag. The deck on the table is for you to use and save. Any auto-generated Legacy Cards by the setup should be manually deleted when you complete the month (win or lose).

Always check both sides of a Legacy Card.
